mapper.select: select count(*) from biz_book b where
select count(*) from biz_used_book ub where

select b.book_id as bookId, b.book_no as bookNo, b.isbn, b.title, b.subtitle, b.author, b.translator, b.publisher_name as publisherName, b.publish_date as publishDate, b.edition, b.binding, b.page_count as pageCount, b.category_id as categoryId, b.book_type as bookType, b.price, b.member_price as memberPrice, b.cover_url as coverUrl, b.summary, b.summary_source as summarySource, b.status, b.publish_status as publishStatus, b.sale_count as saleCount, (select c.category_name from biz_category c where c.category_id = b.category_id) as categoryName from biz_book b where b.book_id = #{bookId} and b.del_flag = '0'
select b.book_id as bookId from biz_book b where b.isbn = #{isbn} and b.del_flag = '0' limit 1

select coalesce(sum(qty_available), 0) as qtyAvailable, coalesce(sum(qty_locked), 0) as qtyLocked, coalesce(sum(qty_borrowed), 0) as qtyBorrowed, coalesce(sum(qty_damaged), 0) as qtyDamaged from biz_stock where store_id = 1 and book_id = #{bookId}

select l.location_id as locationId, l.location_code as locationCode, l.location_name as locationName, l.zone as zone, concat(l.zone, ' ', l.shelf_no, '排', l.layer_no, '层') as shelfHint, s.qty_available as qtyAvailable, s.qty_locked as qtyLocked, s.qty_borrowed as qtyBorrowed, s.qty_damaged as qtyDamaged from biz_stock s join biz_location l on l.location_id = s.location_id where s.store_id = 1 and s.book_id = #{bookId} order by s.qty_available desc, l.location_code

select summary_id as summaryId, gen_type as genType, content, source_type as sourceType, publish_time as publishTime from biz_ai_summary where book_id = #{bookId} and status = 4 order by gen_type, summary_id desc

select ub.used_book_id as usedBookId, ub.bar_code as barCode, ub.condition_grade_id as conditionGradeId, ub.condition_grade_name as conditionGradeName, (select g.grade_desc from biz_condition_grade g where g.grade_id = ub.condition_grade_id) as conditionDesc, ub.origin_price as originPrice, ub.used_price as usedPrice, ub.stock_status as stockStatus from biz_used_book ub where ub.book_id = #{bookId} and ub.stock_status = 1 order by ub.used_price asc

select category_id as categoryId, parent_id as parentId, category_name as categoryName, category_level as categoryLevel, book_count as bookCount, order_num as orderNum from biz_category where store_id = 1 and del_flag = '0' and status = '0' order by category_level, order_num, category_id

select b.book_id as bookId, b.isbn, b.title, b.author, b.cover_url as coverUrl, b.price, b.sale_count as saleCount, (select min(ub.used_price) from biz_used_book ub where ub.book_id = b.book_id and ub.stock_status = 1) as usedPrice from biz_book b where b.store_id = 1 and b.del_flag = '0' and b.publish_status = 1 and b.status <> 4 order by b.sale_count desc, b.book_id desc limit #{limit}

select promotion_id as promotionId, promotion_name as promotionName, promotion_type as promotionType, discount_rate as discountRate, threshold_amount as thresholdAmount, reduce_amount as reduceAmount, gift_desc as giftDesc, start_time as startTime, end_time as endTime from biz_promotion where store_id = 1 and del_flag = '0' and status = 2 order by priority desc, promotion_id desc limit 10

select distinct b.book_id as bookId, b.isbn, b.title, b.author, b.cover_url as coverUrl, b.price, b.sale_count as saleCount, (select min(ub.used_price) from biz_used_book ub where ub.book_id = b.book_id and ub.stock_status = 1) as usedPrice from biz_book b join biz_order_item oi on oi.book_id = b.book_id join biz_order o on o.order_id = oi.order_id where o.member_id = #{memberId} and o.status in (2, 3, 4) and b.store_id = 1 and b.del_flag = '0' and b.publish_status = 1 and b.status <> 4 order by b.sale_count desc, b.book_id desc limit #{limit}

select ub.used_book_id as usedBookId, ub.book_id as bookId, ub.bar_code as barCode, ub.sku_code as skuCode, ub.isbn, ub.title, ub.author, ub.publisher_name as publisherName, ub.cover_url as coverUrl, ub.condition_grade_id as conditionGradeId, ub.condition_grade_name as conditionGradeName, (select g.grade_desc from biz_condition_grade g where g.grade_id = ub.condition_grade_id) as conditionDesc, ub.origin_price as originPrice, ub.used_price as usedPrice, ub.stock_status as stockStatus, ub.location_id as locationId from biz_used_book ub where ub.used_book_id = #{usedBookId}
select ub.used_book_id as usedBookId, ub.book_id as bookId from biz_used_book ub where ub.bar_code = #{barCode} limit 1
